title: Nonconstancy of the Multiplication-Table Limit Profile
statement: For the limiting profile $f_{\mathrm{Mult}}$ governing the multiplication-table problem, prove that $\max_x f_{\mathrm{Mult}}(x)/\min_x f_{\mathrm{Mult}}(x)>1$; equivalently, prove that the profile is not constant.
